prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, grab it, check and sort it, move to destination, execute specific task. If object not visible, scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckAndSortObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsTargetVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachTarget    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForTarget    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckAndSortObject
		DO MoveToDestination
		DO SpecificTask
	END
